title: How we work
text: A clear, four-phase process from first review to measurable growth.

steps.label: 01 // AUDIT
steps.title: Audit & Positioning
steps.text: Technical audit, competitor review and an AI visibility check.

steps.label: 02 // STRATEGY
steps.title: High-Intent Roadmap
steps.text: A prioritized plan built around the searches that bring in customers.

steps.label: 03 // BUILD
steps.title: Build & Fix
steps.text: Technical fixes, new pages and content improvements, shipped in order of impact.

steps.label: 04 // MEASURE
steps.title: Measure & Improve
steps.text: Monthly reporting on rankings, leads and AI mentions, then the next round of work.
